utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m checking the repair drive sign-in spot now, and I’ll tell you which addresses still need a pickup. If you can cover one route, I’ll point you to the closest one.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — send me the addresses that still need a pickup, and I’ll take the closest route I can cover.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll do that now and send you the pickup addresses as soon as I confirm them.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces, but I think we need hands, tools, and a clear list of what to tackle first. If you can help organize that, I can spread the word around the block.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll put together a quick list of what we need and swing by with an invite soon. Thanks for helping spread the word around the block!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll keep an ear out and pass the invite along. Once you’ve got the list, I can help nudge folks who might be able to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Oren — I could use a roll of duct tape, a Phillips screwdriver, and a box of zip ties if you’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that, Cleo — I’ll sort the donations and keep track of who’s coming by.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey — that would be a huge help. If you spot any duct tape, a Phillips screwdriver, or zip ties, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, Hana — I’m a bit scattered today, but I can help with the repair drive. Tell me what you need, and I’ll do my best.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Oren — could you remind me what needs fixing for the repair drive? I want to make sure I have the details right before I ask for help.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m a bit fuzzy on the full list, but I know we were gathering a few small repair items for the drive. If you tell me what you’re checking, I’ll help sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m checking the repair drive schedule around school pickup, and I’ll coordinate from there.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks — that timing sounds better. I think we still need to fix the loose fence, the broken porch steps, and that squeaky gate.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Got it — I’ll check the schedule and keep those repairs lined up around pickup.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Uli — could you bring your drill and a couple screwdrivers, and help sort the donated parts too?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, I can do that. I’ll bring my drill and screwdrivers and help sort the donated parts too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Uli — that’s a huge help. See you at the repair drive!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll swing by the repair drive later and see what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Ira. Can you let me know what you find and whether you’ll need any tools or parts?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely — I’ll check what’s needed and let you know if tools or parts are missing.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds fine to me — I’ll come by after my errands and check what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll keep the plan moving and put together the first-tackle list. After your errands, come by and we’ll see what hands and tools are still needed.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — I’ll finish my errands and then stop by to check the list and see what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: You got it — I’ll bring my drill and a couple screwdrivers, and I can help sort the donated parts too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s perfect, Sam — a drill and screwdrivers will be super useful, and help sorting parts is great too. I still haven’t heard the exact time, but I’ll let you know the moment I do!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Tess — just let me know the time when you hear it, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I haven’t seen a cancellation, so I think it’s still on today, but I’d double-check the timing before you rely on it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — so it’s still on today, but I should double-check the time first?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, that’s right — I’d check the time before heading over, just to be safe.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Leo, sorry I’m late — what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: No worries — we’re set for now. Just bring the wrench set and a flashlight if you’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll bring the wrench set and a flashlight.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ll check the latest details and see what supplies we still need, then I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—just give me the quick version when you’ve got it, and I’ll grab a wrench set and flashlight if needed.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ve got the quick version: we’re still short on a few basics, and your wrench set and flashlight would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, I’ll keep it simple and be ready when you get there.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Eli — I’ll wait for the final plan and jump in where needed.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Dane — just let me know the final plan when it’s set, and I’ll be ready.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Bo — I’m checking the repair drive schedule around school pickup, and then I can coordinate from there.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I’ve got both — I’ll bring the wrench set and flashlight over.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks, Bo — I’ll keep the pickup timing in mind and coordinate from there.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, thanks, Bo. See you there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Leo — see you there, and I appreciate the help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: No problem, Gus. I’ll see you there.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: You got it — I’ll bring my drill and a couple of screwdrivers, and I can help sort the donated parts too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s great, Sam — thank you. I’ll add you to the helper list and start matching the donated parts with the homes that need them most.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Rosa — thanks for organizing it. Let me know where you want me to start when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, please check who’s available, and note whether they can help with setup, repairs, or cleanup.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Got it — I’ll check who’s available and note whether they can help with setup, repairs, or cleanup.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Leo. That helps a lot — I’ll plan to come by early on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll swing by early with an invite and whatever supplies I can gather. I’ll also keep spreading the word to a few more neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Quinn—that’s a big help. If you can, bring the invite, tape, screwdriver, and zip ties; I’ll keep a list going here.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: You got it—I’ll bring the invite, tape, screwdriver, and zip ties when I swing by. I’ll also keep nudging a couple more neighbors to join in.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—Saturday morning works for me. I’ll bring the tools list and whatever spare parts I have.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, then let’s meet Saturday morning and sort the timing when we get there.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds good—Saturday morning it is. I’ll bring the tools list and the spare parts I have.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m happy to help; just tell me what needs fixing and where to drop it off.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So it’s still happening today, right? I just want to double-check the time before I count on it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, it’s still happening today as far as I know. I haven’t heard the latest time yet, but I can check while I’m out and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ve got the first-step list coming, and I’ll repeat the plan to a few neighbors so we can line up hands and tools. What part do you want me to share with Jules first?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Please start with who’s available, and include whether they can help with setup, repairs, or cleanup.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it — I’ll check who’s available and note whether they can do setup, repairs, or cleanup. Then I’ll repeat that plan to the neighbors so we can line up hands and tools.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, Tess — I’m a bit scattered today, but I can check the repair drive schedule and help keep it clear around school pickup. Tell me what you need from me.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Oren — that’d be a big help. I’m still waiting on the exact time and list, but if you can check the schedule and keep the pickup area clear, I’ll pass along anything else I hear.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I’ll check the schedule and keep the pickup area clear. Just send me the details when you get them.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ll check the latest details and see what we still need, then I’ll let you know so we can get everything set.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Mara. I’ll keep an eye out and let you know what I find once I’ve checked around.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Rey — I appreciate it. I’ll compare notes and let you know what we still need once I’ve checked the latest details.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m checking the repair drive sign-in spot now, then I’ll point you to the closest route that still needs a pickup.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Opal — I’ve heard a couple folks mention loose steps and a leaky faucet, so I’ll pass those along if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That helps a lot—please send those along, and I’ll match them to the nearest pickup route once I confirm the sign-in spot.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
